summary: We have created a 3D topographic map that we believe could assist with NASA’s planned missions to Mars. This map allows for a detailed, three-dimensional view of the entire surface of Mars. Why choose our project? It will help ensure that future NASA missions—including those involving human crews—can land safely and securely on the Martian surface.
details: Our project is an interactive Martian Information and Mapping Web Application developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It focuses on mapping key Martian geological features, with a primary emphasis on the Jezero Crater and its surrounding sedimentary deposits, to help visualize landing sites and surface morphology.We used Claude as a coding language.
